verdict.rationale: Shopify POS's own docs say inventory at every location syncs in real time across POS, the online store, and every sales channel. They also cover stock counts and receiving shipments in POS. Catalog management itself (creating and editing items) is only implied, and a community report of an integer overflow that broke inventory counts shows a past sync failure, though not a lasting contradiction. Missing for 10: documented catalog/item creation and editing workflow, explicit multi-register (device-to-device) inventory sync evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable sync.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels

citations.quote: Track and assign inventory at every location that syncs in real time across POS, online store, and every sales channel.
Shopify POS syncs with Shopify to track your orders and inventory across your retail locations, online store, and other active sales channels.
Use Quick counts with a barcode scanner to update stock quantities on the spot in Shopify POS.
Accept incoming shipments from other locations or suppliers in Shopify POS, manually or with a barcode scanner.
